mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in the federal funds rate indicates an ongoing monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months with a positive FEDFUNDS change, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 305.0 indicates persistent inflation, prompting the Fed to maintain high interest rates, which supports corporate profit margins and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months with CPIAUCSL > 305.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment falls below 4.0% and residential sales exceed 690,000 million, it indicates a tight labor market and strong consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime (INDPRO < 100.0), reduced industrial output signals economic contraction, which depresses equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months with INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, which increases consumer spending and corporate revenues, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months with a positive PAYEMS change, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) reading above 1500.0 thousand units indicates a robust housing market, which drives consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months with HOUST > 1500.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) signal an overheated economy, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (RSAFS > 690,000 million and HOUST < 1450.0 thousand units), high consumer spending combined with weak housing activity signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
